primitives.name: Primitives: Points Build Worlds
primitives.truth: A point is position without extension. Everything is built from nothing.
primitives.qfep_connection: Stable foundations before entropy enters. The deterministic base from which complexity grows. Primitives are pure order—the F term before λE(S) introduces chaos.
primitives.demonstration: Place a point in void. Connect two points to make a line. Three points define a plane. From nothing, everything.
primitives.description: Fundamental geometric primitives and their axioms. The atoms of computation—dimensionless points become lines, triangles, cubes, worlds.
